stories_kpis.Explanation: Strategic shift from hardware-driven model to cloud-based SaaS applications
stories_kpis.Signal: Transition en cours vers les solutions SaaS avec augmentation des revenus récurrents
stories_kpis.Description: L'entreprise transite ses clients des solutions legacy vers des applications SaaS microservices modernes intégrées nativement à sa plateforme cloud propriétaire

stories_kpis.Name_fr: Transition du modèle matériel vers ODM
stories_kpis.Name_en: Hardware Business Transition to ODM model
stories_kpis.Explanation: Transition of self-checkout and point-of-sale hardware to outsourced design and manufacturing model
stories_kpis.Signal: Implémentation en phase de transition du nouveau modèle matériel avec Ennoconn depuis janvier 2026
stories_kpis.Description: En août 2024, NCR Voyix a conclu un accord commercial avec Ennoconn pour transitionner ses activités de matériel vers un modèle d'externalisation. En janvier 2026, la phase de mise en œuvre a commencé.

ai_positioning.summary: NCR Voyix mentionne l'intelligence artificielle dans le contexte des tendances macroéconomiques et des demandes des clients. L'entreprise note que les pénuries mondiales de puces microélectroniques sont en partie dues à l'adoption de l'IA. Cependant, aucun développement ou produit spécifique liés à l'IA n'est détaillé dans le rapport 10-K.
evidence: Global shortages of microchips and other technology components, primarily driven by the adoption of artificial intelligence

risks.title: Cyber Ransomware Incident
risks.score_rationale: Incident documented explicitly in Item 1A. April 2023 ransomware attack caused data center outage impacting Aloha cloud-based services and Counterpoint. Cumulative costs of $47M incurred with $37M recovered through insurance. Recent and material financial impact.
risks.summary: NCR Voyix suffered a cyber ransomware incident in April 2023 affecting specific cloud-based services. The company fully restored functionality and built new infrastructure. Total costs reached $47M with partial recovery from insurance, representing a material operational and financial impact.

risks.title: Decline in Product Revenue (Hardware and Software Licenses)
risks.score_rationale: All other revenue (non-recurring) declined 15% in 2025 and 23% in 2024, reflecting the strategic decline of legacy hardware and license-based revenue streams as the company transitions to SaaS and recurring revenue models.
risks.summary: Product revenue from hardware and software licenses is declining as part of the company's strategic transition to SaaS and recurring revenue models. All other revenue fell from 49.1% of total revenue in 2023 to 37.6% in 2025, a structural shift that continues to impact total revenue growth.

risks.title: Concentration Risk on Recurring Revenue
risks.score_rationale: Recurring revenue increased from 50.9% in 2023 to 62.4% in 2025, while all other revenue contracted from 49.1% to 37.6%. This structural shift increases exposure to disruptions in recurring revenue streams and customer retention.
risks.summary: The company increasingly depends on recurring revenue from contracts and subscriptions, which now represents 62.4% of total revenue. Any disruption to these recurring revenue streams or decline in customer retention would have a significant impact on financial stability.

risks.title: Transformation and Restructuring Costs
risks.score_rationale: Material transformation and restructuring costs are explicitly mentioned as EBITDA adjustments and items affecting results. These represent significant near-term financial burdens as the company executes its strategic transformation to SaaS and platform-based models.
risks.summary: The company is incurring substantial costs related to its transformation and restructuring initiatives, including the transition from hardware to ODM model and shift to SaaS solutions. These near-term costs impact profitability despite long-term strategic benefits.

risks.title: Foreign Currency Exposure
risks.score_rationale: The company operates globally with exposure to multiple currencies. Historical impacts from foreign currency devaluation are reflected in EBITDA adjustments, indicating structural exposure to exchange rate fluctuations, particularly in developing markets.
risks.summary: As a multinational corporation with significant international operations, NCR Voyix faces ongoing exposure to foreign currency fluctuations and devaluation risks, particularly in certain geographic markets, which can negatively impact reported financial results.

risks.title: Regulatory Compliance and Payment Processing Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company's payments business is subject to complex regulatory requirements from payment networks, card brands, and financial regulations. Non-compliance could result in fines, penalties, revocation of registration, or loss of sponsor bank relationships, any of which could materially harm operations.
risks.summary: NCR Voyix's payments-related business requires sponsorship by banks and registration with card brands. Changes in payment network regulations, card brand rules, or PCI DSS standards could require significant development investments or restrict service offerings, impacting revenue and profitability.

governance.voting_structure: Une seule classe d'actions ordinaires et Series A Convertible Preferred Stock votant ensemble sur base convertie, 1 vote par action ordinaire.
